sceneDescription: In a hyper-realistic, brightly-lit jewelry showroom, a wide conveyor belt runs horizontally through the center of the space. Instead of gems or jewelry, the conveyor transports miniature, photorealistic storefront façades—one looks like a classic Boston jewelry shop, another mimics a sleek tech store, another resembles an online checkout counter physically rendered. Each storefront has jewelry displayed in their windows, but also strange objects: a gold-plated computer mouse, a diamond-encrusted chatbot icon, and a necklace made of tiny shopping carts. Tiny, shiny robot hands occasionally pop out from the belt, trying to swipe jewelry from the displays, leaving a trail of sparkling, scattered gemstones behind—hinting at fraud. The showroom is opulent but feels slightly absurd due to the moving mini-stores and odd jewelry. The lighting is natural and crisp, with the conveyor and storefronts as the central horizontal band. No text, signage, or screens, just playful photorealism with polished metals, glass, and velvet textures.
